title: A mesh-free deep energy method for phase-field modeling of thermally driven brittle fracture
abstract: arXiv:2611.17630v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Phase-field simulation of thermally driven fracture requires resolving localized crack bands whose paths are unknown in advance and thermal boundary layers whose thickness evolves during the transient. Neural energy-based computations of thermal fracture have so far started from defects placed in advance. This paper proposes a mesh-free deep energy method based on multiresolution neural representations that predicts spontaneous crack nucleation, crack spacing, and selective crack propagation and arrest under transient thermal loading. Two networks, each with its own multiresolution encoding, represent the displacement and phase fields and the transient temperature, and the mechanical energy and the incremental functional of the backward Euler heat equation are estimated on integration points redrawn at every iteration. translated_title: 一种用于热驱动脆性断裂相场建模的无网格深度能量方法
translated_abstract: 热驱动断裂的相场模拟需要解析裂纹路径预先未知的局部化裂纹带，以及在瞬态过程中厚度不断变化的热边界层。迄今为止，基于神经能量的热断裂计算都是从预先放置的缺陷出发的。本文提出了一种基于多分辨率神经表示的无网格深度能量方法，能够在瞬态热载荷下预测自发裂纹成核、裂纹间距以及选择性的裂纹扩展与止裂。两个网络（各自具有独立的多分辨率编码）分别表示位移场与相场以及瞬态温度场，机械能和后向欧拉热方程的增量泛函在每次迭代时重新生成的积分点上进行估计。通过将不可逆性约束限制在裂纹集合上、跨载荷步传递优化器状态并衰减学习率……（摘要内容不完整，此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种基于多分辨率神经表示的无网格深度能量方法，无需预先放置缺陷即可在瞬态热载荷下预测脆性断裂的自发裂纹成核、裂纹间距以及选择性的裂纹扩展与止裂。
en_tdlr: A mesh-free deep energy method based on multiresolution neural representations is proposed to predict spontaneous crack nucleation, crack spacing, and selective crack propagation and arrest under transient thermal loading, without requiring pre-placed defects.
